Casual Portrait of a Young Man

A young man sits comfortably on a bench in what appears to be a creative studio or office, leaning forward with his hands clasped. He wears a bright green tie-dye T-shirt featuring a graphic print, paired with blue jeans adorned with zippers and chains, and a camo-patterned cap tilted slightly to the side. Behind him, large maps and posters cover the wall, adding an artistic backdrop to the scene.

His relaxed posture and direct gaze convey confidence and ease. The combination of vibrant clothing and the detailed background suggests a modern, urban environment where personal style and creativity intersect.

Zhang Shanwei’s Home Rehabilitation

Zhang Shanwei, the actor famous for his “Tadpole” role in “麻辣鮮師” and later as “Black Skin Brother” on a children’s channel, has been living a private life since his 2013 spinal injury left him paralyzed from the waist down. He relies on family members and medical devices to assist with movement and daily care, and the pandemic has further restricted in-person visits from his assistant and friends.
